name: plix-guest-app
description: Standalone Android shell for The Plix - Villas & Stays (com.theplix.app), the public guest booking site. Independent of the Plix Partner (com.plix.partner) and Plix PMS (com.plix.pms) apps.

scripts.build:aab: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:apk: cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
